title: The Jelly Update Mod
description: If Mojang released a Jelly Update!?
body:
_If Minecraft had a Jelly Update!?_

the Jelly can be crafted with Blueberries or Strawberries and glass. \
1=Strawberry \
2=Blueberry \
3=Glass

**[ 3 ][ 3 ][ 3 ]Glass \
[1/2][1/2][1/2]Strawberry/Blueberry \
[1/2][1/2][1/2]Strawberry/Blueberry**

or you have a chance of getting green jelly while mining.

and to make the jellyverse portal lighter and the portal itself,
craft a arrow without the flint.

If you want me to update this more often, then please follow this project!
